children: Columbus Acquisition announced a reconvened Extraordinary General Meeting for Sept. 28, 2026 and an extended redemption deadline of Sept. 24, 2026.
Meeting adjourned on Sept. 10 without votes; reconvened Meeting set for Sept. 28, 2026 to consider the WISeSat.Space combination.
Extended Redemption Deadline established as Sept. 24, 2026; public shareholders must follow proxy procedures to redeem.
Approximately $10.79 per share remains in trust as of Sept. 23, 2026, relevant to redemption value.
Record date for voting remains Aug. 17, 2026; shareholders of record on that date are eligible to vote even if shares were sold.
